news.title: Rokeya University students go on hunger strike with 5-point demand
news.snippet: The students began the strike in front of the main gate of Academic Building-2 around 11am.

news.title: Whether courts or govt approve Hasina extradition is India's matter: ICT chief prosecutor
news.snippet: Aminul Islam says the Indian government has yet to clearly explain Sheikh Hasina’s current status in the country, noting that Bangladesh has already conveyed the matter to New Delhi but has received no clear response.

news.title: Govt eyes vetiver grass to check river erosion, save embankments: Water resources minister
news.snippet: The minister said the roots of Binna grass penetrate deep into the soil and hold it firmly in place, helping reduce erosion caused by rainwater, waves and currents.

news.title: Govt to prioritise concrete blocks over bricks in public construction: Minister
news.snippet: The government plans to promote concrete blocks over traditional bricks in public projects to protect farmland and reduce pollution and carbon emissions.

news.title: Govt forms high-level committee on tea sector loans, financing
news.snippet: The committee will also provide recommendations on declaring tea an agricultural product and commercially installing solar panels on unused land in tea gardens.

news.title: Shama Obaed stresses equal education opportunities for all
news.snippet: he said the government was giving serious attention to removing barriers to education for children from economically disadvantaged families.

news.title: Noab to oversee newspaper distribution, bill collection in Dhaka
news.snippet: The Bangladesh Newspaper Circulation Managers Association will manage all activities of the hawkers’ cooperative under Noab’s supervision.

news.title: Satkhira youths plant paddy on road to protest poor condition
news.snippet: Locals say the muddy road makes it extremely difficult to take sick people to hospital.

news.title: Dhaka robbery gang busted; 'ringleader' with 45 cases arrested
news.snippet: Police recovered fake RAB and DB vests, a police-logo handcuff, weapons and a private car allegedly used in robberies.

news.title: Ctg Port removes 15,000 metres of illegal fishing nets from shipping channel
news.snippet: The seized nets and other fishing equipment had been obstructing vessel movement along the navigation route and posed a serious risk to ships using the port, the authority said.

news.title: Fire guts Bangshal helmet warehouse, flames brought under control after 2hrs
news.snippet: No casualties reported yet.

news.title: BRTC to launch 'Pink Bus' service for women on 18 August
news.snippet: The new transport service, operated entirely by female drivers and conductors, aims to ensure safe commuting for women as part of the government's election manifesto.

news.title: Lighter Vessel Management Software launched to boost transparency at Ctg Port
news.snippet: Razib said vessel owners had long complained about the system used to determine the sequence in which lighter vessels receive cargo from mother vessels.

news.title: All upazila health complexes to become nine-storey facilities: Sakhawat
news.snippet: Corruption had also taken place in the purchase of medicines for hospitals during the fascist government, Sakhawat said, adding the government wants to bring the country’s health sector and medical system under a new discipline.

news.title: Dengue death toll hits 70 as 3 more die in 24hrs
news.snippet: With the latest fatalities, the dengue death toll has risen to 70 in the country this year, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

news.title: Senior journalist Nurul Hasan Khan passes away
news.snippet: The former ERF general secretary and National Press Club joint secretary died while undergoing treatment at a Dhaka hospital

news.title: Primary students may get speaking tests alongside written English exams: Bobby Hajjaj
news.snippet: The planned assessment aims to improve students’ English communication skills under the next primary education curriculum

news.title: Protect water bodies, ensure sustainable fisheries: PM
news.snippet: Fisheries play a vital role in meeting the country’s nutritional needs while creating employment through fish farming, catching, transportation, processing and marketing, PM says.

news.title: 3 more testify in Tk25cr UCB money laundering case against ex-land minister Saifuzzaman
news.snippet: The court has now examined 40 of the 92 witnesses listed in the charge sheet, with the next hearing set for 27 August.

news.title: Sylhet triple murder: Prime suspect Babul placed on 4-day remand
news.snippet: Sylhet Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Farhana Sultana passed the order.
